answer: Escrow until finality, then release on a signed task hash. Edges decay, so an attestation from six epochs ago carries less weight than yesterday's. No identity may audit its own recruit, which closes the obvious edge case of a parent vouching for a child it funded. Every fake identity then needs an unrelated voucher with a live edge plus capital parked until finality. The tide of new addresses does not move the delta of real scores. An ivory badge with no edge behind it reads as zero.
